Sells mainly business to business from chemical plants, with technical support for customers' formulations.

customer_segment.value: B2B: formulators and manufacturers in personal care, pharmaceutical, coatings, construction and food industries

end_markets.value: personal care; pharmaceuticals; coatings; construction; food and beverage

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes specialty chemical ingredients from raw materials, sold to formulators and manufacturers
